tagline: Tumhara home router broadband network mein login kaise karta hai.
description: Kai fibre aur DSL providers router ko online aane se pehle login karwate hain. PPPoE Ethernet par ISP ka access concentrator dhoondta hai, phir uske andar PPP chalata hai jo link settings agree karta hai, tumhara username aur password check karta hai, aur tumhara public IP address aur DNS servers deta hai.
facts: PPP ke andar CHAP ya PAP

normal.name: Router dial in karta hai
normal.summary: Router ISP dhoondta hai, CHAP se login karta hai, public IP paata hai, traffic carry karta hai, phir hang up karta hai.

steps.title: ISP ke liye awaaz lagao
steps.detail: Router ko abhi ISP ka MAC address nahi pata, isliye woh WAN port par PADI broadcast karta hai. Jo bhi access concentrator ise sunta hai woh PADO se jawab de sakta hai. Router ka Host-Uniq tag bina badle wapas aata hai taaki use pata chale ki offer uski apni request ka jawab hai.

quiz.q: PADI broadcast address par jata hai. Kyun?
options: Router ko abhi koi ISP MAC address nahi pata
Seedha RADIUS server tak pahunchne ke liye
quiz.why: DHCP ki tarah, pehla message broadcast hota hai kyunki router ko pata nahi kaun jawab dega. Replies unicast hote hain.

steps.title: Ek offer chuno
steps.desc: PADR request, PADS session ID deta hai
steps.detail: Router pehla offer chunta hai aur unicast PADR bhejta hai, jisme AC-Cookie echo karke sabit karta hai ki usne sach mein PADO dekha tha. Concentrator PADS se jawab deta hai jisme session ID hota hai, yahan 0x1a2b. Ab se har frame EtherType 0x8864 aur isi ID ka use karta hai.

quiz.q: PADR khud kaunsa Session ID carry karta hai?
quiz.why: Session ID sirf PADS reply se banta hai, isliye usse pehle ke har discovery message mein 0 hota hai.

steps.title: Link settings agree karo
steps.desc: LCP Configure-Request aur Ack, dono taraf
steps.detail: Ab session ke andar PPP shuru hota hai. Har side apne chahiye options ke saath LCP Configure-Request bhejti hai, aur dusri side unhe acknowledge karti hai. ISP 1492-byte MRU maangta hai aur kehta hai ki login CHAP with MD5 se hoga. Har side looped lines pakadne ke liye ek random magic number bhi chunti hai.

options: PPPoE aur PPP headers 1500-byte Ethernet frame ke 8 bytes le lete hain
Fibre 1500 bytes carry nahi kar sakti
quiz.why: PPPoE header ke 6 bytes aur PPP protocol field ke 2 bytes 1500-byte Ethernet payload ke andar baithte hain, aur IP ke liye 1492 bachte hain.

steps.title: Sabit karo tum kaun ho
steps.detail: Concentrator 16 random bytes bhejta hai. Router identifier, apna broadband password aur challenge ko MD5 se hash karta hai, aur sirf hash aur username bhejta hai. Concentrator RADIUS server se puchta hai, jo stored password ke saath wahi hisaab karta hai. Dono match karte hain, isliye jawab Success hota hai.

quiz.q: Koi CHAP Response capture kar leta hai. Kya woh use replay karke baad mein login kar sakta hai?
options: Nahi, agla login naye random challenge ka use karta hai
Haan, agar woh MAC spoof kare
quiz.why: Hash challenge par depend karta hai, jo har baar fresh hota hai. Purana response naye challenge se match nahi karega.

steps.title: IP address lo
steps.desc: IPCP public IP aur DNS deta hai
steps.detail: Yahan DHCP nahi hai. Router IPCP se address 0.0.0.0 aur DNS 0.0.0.0 maangta hai, jiska matlab hai “please batao”. Concentrator Configure-Nak se jawab deta hai jo 198.51.100.7 aur DNS servers 192.0.2.53 aur 192.0.2.54 bhar deta hai. Router un values ke saath phir maangta hai aur Ack paata hai.

quiz.q: Router IP 0.0.0.0 maangta hai. Concentrator kya wapas bhejta hai?
quiz.why: Nak ka matlab hai “woh value nahi, yeh use karo”. Router phir suggested address ke saath apni request dohrata hai.

steps.title: Asli traffic carry karo
steps.desc: PPPoE ke andar PPP ke andar IP packets
steps.detail: Laptop web connection kholta hai. Router laptop ke private address ko 198.51.100.7 se badalta hai aur packet ko PPP header (protocol 0x0021) aur PPPoE session header mein lapet deta hai. Woh TCP MSS ko bhi ghata kar 1452 kar deta hai taaki full-size segments 1492 bytes mein fit ho jayein.

quiz.q: MTU 1492 hai. Sabse bada TCP payload (MSS) kitna fit hota hai?
quiz.why: 1492 minus IP header ke 20 bytes minus TCP header ke 20 bytes se 1452 bachta hai.

steps.title: Hang up
steps.detail: Router reboot hota hai ya user disconnect karta hai to PPP tameez se LCP Terminate-Request aur Terminate-Ack se band hota hai. Phir router PPPoE session ko khatam karne ke liye PADT bhejta hai, taaki ISP session ID aur public IP free kar sake.

outro.title: Login, use, logout
outro.text: PPPoE ne chaar discovery frames mein ISP dhoondha, phir PPP ne LCP se link set kiya, CHAP se password check kiya aur IPCP se address diya. Uske baad har packet 8 extra bytes carry karta hai, isliye PPPoE links 1492-byte MTU use karte hain.

chap-fail.name: Galat broadband password
chap-fail.summary: Router ISP ko theek se dhoondta hai, lekin uska CHAP response match nahi karta aur session tod diya jata hai.

steps.title: Session up ho jata hai
steps.desc: Discovery aur LCP normal kaam karte hain
steps.detail: Discovery aur LCP koi password check nahi karte, isliye shuru mein sab normal dikhta hai. Router ko session ID milti hai aur woh link options agree karta hai, jisme login method CHAP hai.

steps.title: Challenge ka jawab do
steps.desc: Hash galat password se bana hai
steps.detail: Kisi ne router ki settings mein password typo ke saath daala. Router phir bhi use challenge ke saath hash karta hai aur result bhejta hai. Packet mein kuch galat nahi dikhta, kyunki password khud kabhi nahi bheja jata.

quiz.q: ISP ko kaise pata chalta hai ki password galat hai?
options: Woh response se password decrypt kar leta hai
Woh expected hash compute karke compare karta hai
quiz.why: RADIUS wahi identifier, challenge aur stored password par MD5 compute karta hai. Alag result ka matlab alag password.

steps.title: Rejected
steps.detail: Concentrator CHAP Failure bhejta hai, LCP Terminate-Request se PPP band karta hai, aur PADT se PPPoE session khatam karta hai. Router authentication error dikhata hai (aksar “PPP authentication failed”) aur thodi der baad retry karta hai. Baar-baar fail hone par line kuch der ke liye block ho sakti hai.

quiz.q: Is baar PADT kaun bhejta hai?
options: Koi nahi, time out hota hai
quiz.why: ISP ne tay kiya ki login fail hua, isliye woh apna banaya session khatam karta hai. Koi bhi side PADT bhej sakti hai.

outro.title: Password theek hone tak internet nahi
outro.text: Discovery aur LCP bina password ke succeed hote hain, isliye galat password sirf CHAP step par dikhta hai. ISP Failure se jawab deta hai aur sab kuch tod deta hai. CHAP password kabhi nahi bhejta, isliye fix hamesha router par hota hai: ISP se mile exact username aur password dobara daalo.
